description:
Start a new Site Audit (technical crawl) run for a property. WRITE action — requires the write scope. It spends the project's crawler credits (separate from MCP credits) in proportion to the number of pages to crawl, marks the audit as running and queues the crawl; results then become available to the read tools (get_site_audit_summary etc.) once the crawl finishes. Only audits in mode "complete" (recrawl all discovered pages) or "list" (the configured URL list) can be triggered via MCP; "organic_traffic" audits are not supported here (unsupported_crawl_mode). Returns audit_id, mode, status, started_at and pages_queued. Errors: crawl_already_running if a crawl is already in progress, insufficient_crawler_credits if the project lacks enough crawler credits, no_audit if the property has no audit configured, audit_not_found for an unknown auditId. Defaults to the most-recently-finished audit; pass the auditId argument (an audit_id from list_site_audit_projects) to target a specific one. Pass the property ID (UUID) or URL (sc-domain:...) from list_properties.

Cost: 1 credit per call.

Examples:
```json
// Trigger a fresh crawl of the property's latest site audit.
{"property":"sc-domain:example.com"}
```
name: trigger_site_audit_crawl
title: Start site audit crawl
